text:
[LSMP.3.2] Not admitted, with the reason:

| Aggregation | Why undefined over a reservoir bag |
|---|---|
| `first`, `last` | reservoir sampling does not preserve insertion order |
| `rate`, `direction` | a reservoir bag has no time axis |
| `bool_and`, `bool_or` | an **exact predicate**, not a statistic: a uniform sample can omit the one value that determines the AND/OR, so the reduction over the sample is not a faithful answer over all observations (LSER.16.8.3) |
| `count_distinct` | a uniform sample under-counts distinct values; cardinality is not preserved |
| `count_of` | reservoir sampling does not preserve observation counts |
| `contains` | a random sample answers "is this value in the bag", not "ever observed" |
